walls.note: Mechelen town wall c.1650 (14th-c. outer wall with later bastions), traced from the Ferraris map (1777). Local metres around the Grote Markt (x east, z south). Gate names: Dutch renderings of the French labels on the Villaret map (1745-48); positions from Ferraris.

landmarks.y1650: West tower of Sint-Rombouts, built 1452-1520 to a design for a spire of about 167 m and left unfinished at about 97 m, as it still stands; the main bell tower of Mechelen.

landmarks.n: Lakenhalle en Paleis van de Grote Raad
landmarks.y1650: The 14th-c. cloth hall on the Grote Markt, and the palace begun in 1526 by Rombout Keldermans for the Great Council, left unfinished (completed only in 1900-11).
Aldermen's house (from 1288), seat of the Great Council of the Netherlands until it moved to the Hof van Savoye in 1618.
Palace of Margaret of Austria (d. 1530); from 1618 seat of the Great Council.
The great beguinage moved inside the walls after its destruction in 1578; its church was built 1629-47.
Gate of c. 1300, the only one of twelve to survive.
landmarks.src: Inventaris Onroerend Erfgoed, 'Historische stadskern van Mechelen' (id.erfgoed.net/erfgoedobjecten/140035)

ruler.name: Heerlijkheid Mechelen
